info.title: Nexrender API
info.description:
REST API for the Nexrender cloud rendering platform, enabling programmatic control over After Effects template processing, job management, and asset handling.

Features include:

- Template upload and management (AEP, MOGRT, ZIP files)
- Job creation and status monitoring with real-time progress
- Job nesting for multi-composition renders (parent/child jobs)
- Job stitching to combine multiple videos into one
- Batch job creation for submitting up to 1000 jobs at once
- Font library management for typography consistency
- Secret management for secure API key storage
- Webhook notifications for job lifecycle events
- Asset injection for dynamic content replacement

Authentication is required for all endpoints using Bearer token authorization.

apiToken.description:
Bearer token authentication using API tokens for team-based access control.

You can generate your own API token at: https://app.nexrender.com/settings/api-tokens

Font.description: Font file metadata for team-shared typography resources used in After Effects rendering

familyName.description: Font family name (e.g., "Arial", "Helvetica Neue") extracted from font metadata (or custom)

fileName.description: Original font file name as uploaded (supports TTF only). This is the file name referenced in pushed jobs.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the font was uploaded and processed

JobAsset.description: Asset to be used in job rendering, containing source information and target layer details. For function assets, provide the function identifier in `name` and arguments in `params`.

src.description: Source URL, script data or file path for the asset (supports HTTP/HTTPS URLs or local paths)

type.description: Asset type (e.g., image, video, audio, text, data, script, job)

layerName.description: Target layer name in the After Effects composition where this asset will be applied

name.description: Human-readable name for the asset. For function assets (`type: function`), this should be the NX function name (for example, `nx:layer-autoscale`).

conform.description: When true for video, image, or audio assets, the worker normalizes the downloaded media to a render-engine-safe target format before assembly. If omitted, the API auto-enables conform for known risky inputs such as WebM, WebP, GIF, and OGG/OGA sources. GIF inputs are converted to a ProRes 4444 MOV file and treated as video.

params.description: Optional parameters for function assets. For supported NX layer functions (`nx:layer-autoscale`, `nx:layer-duration-set`, `nx:layer-start-set`, `nx:layer-state-set`, `nx:solid-color-set`, `nx:text-params-set`), `params.layerName` accepts a single string or an array of strings. When an array is provided, the API expands the function asset into multiple per-layer assets while preserving the original `assets` order.

layerName.description: Target layer name(s) for function assets

oneOf.description: Multiple target layer names (supported by selected NX layer functions only)

JobAssetNested.description: A nested job asset that renders a child job first, then uses its output as a video/image asset in the parent composition. The child job's output URL is automatically injected into the parent's assets.

layerName.description: Target layer name in the parent composition where the child job's output will be placed (required)

template.description: Template configuration for the child job

id.description: Template ID for the child job (required)

composition.description: Composition name to render in the child job (required)

assets.description: Assets to inject into the child job

preview.description: Generate preview quality for the child job

settings.description: Render settings for the child job

type.description: Output type for the child job

engine.description: After Effects render engine version for the child job

JoinVideoAsset.description: A static video asset for the join/stitch operation

type.description: Must be 'video' for static video assets

src.description: URL to the video file to include in the stitch

JoinJobAsset.description: A job asset that will be rendered first and its output included in the stitch

template.description: Template configuration for the child job

JobTemplate.description: Template configuration defining the After Effects project and composition to render

JobCreation.description: Configuration object for creating a new render job with template, assets, and options

preview.description: Generate a low-quality preview render instead of full quality output

fonts.description: List of font file names to include in the render environment

assets.description: Collection of media assets (images, videos, audio, scripts, text) or nested job assets (type: 'job') to use in the render. Nested job assets render as child jobs first, with output injected into the parent composition. For supported NX layer functions, `params.layerName` can be a string or an array of strings; array values are expanded in place while preserving asset order.

settings.description: Render configuration settings for output format, quality, and frame selection

type.description: Output render type - 'video' for MP4/MOV files, 'image' for PNG/JPG files, 'aep' for full archive

oneOf.description: Single frame number to render as image
Frame range [start, end] where end > start

frames.description: Frame specification - single frame number or [start, end] range. Required for image type.

quality.description: Render quality setting - 'draft' for faster low-quality preview, 'full' for high-quality output

engine.description: After Effects render engine version used when the job is picked up by a worker

upload.description: Custom upload configuration for output files to external storage providers

prefix.description: Folder prefix/path where output files will be stored (e.g., 'my-project/outputs/')

outputUrl.description: Custom base URL for accessing uploaded files publicly

provider.description: Storage provider - 's3' for Amazon S3 compatible

region.description: AWS region or storage region identifier (required)

bucket.description: Target bucket name for file uploads (required)

acl.description: Access control list setting for uploaded files (e.g., 'public-read', 'private')

accessKeyId.description: AWS access key ID or equivalent credential (required)

accessKeySecret.description: AWS secret access key or equivalent credential (required)

Job.description: Render job with current status, progress, and detailed statistics

id.description: Unique job identifier used for tracking and API operations

templateId.description: Reference to the template used for this job (null if template was not used)

status.description: Current job status (queued, render:dorender, finished, error, etc.). Manually cancelled jobs are normalized to `manually_cancelled` in v2 responses even though they are stored internally as `error`.

progress.description: Render progress as a percentage (0.0 to 100.0)

stats.description: Detailed timing and metadata statistics for the job

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the job was initially created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent job status update

startedAt.description: ISO timestamp when job processing began (null if not started)

finishedAt.description: ISO timestamp when job completed successfully (null if not finished)

errorAt.description: ISO timestamp when job encountered an error (null if no error)

totalAssets.description: Total number of assets included in this job

renderDuration.description: Total render time in seconds (null if not completed)

error.description: Error message if job failed (null if successful)

JobCancellationRequest.description: Request payload for cancelling one or more jobs by ID.

jobs.description: List of job IDs to cancel. Each explicitly requested job must be in a cancellable state.

items.description: Unique job identifier in ULID format

JobCancellationResponse.description: Jobs cancelled by the request, including any related parent, child, or sibling jobs cancelled as part of the same operation. Cancelling a child may trigger sibling cascades when those related jobs are still cancellable.

BatchCreation.description: Configuration for creating a batch of render jobs in a single request (1 to 1000 jobs)

jobs.description: Array of job configurations to create as a batch. Each item follows the same schema as a single job creation request.

BatchCreationResponse.description: Response after creating a batch of jobs, including per-job results and any errors

batchId.description: Unique batch identifier in ULID format for tracking the entire batch

status.description: 'created' if all jobs succeeded, 'partial' if some failed, 'error' if all failed

totalJobs.description: Total number of jobs in the batch request

jobs.description: Array of successfully created job details

index.description: Position of this job in the original request array

status.description: Initial job status ('queued' or 'pending' for parent jobs)

outputUrl.description: URL where the rendered output will be available

children.description: Child job details (only present for jobs with nested job assets)

missingFonts.description: Fonts referenced in template but not found in team's font library

errors.description: Array of errors for failed jobs (only present when status is 'partial' or 'error')

index.description: Position of the failed job in the original request array

error.description: Error message describing why the job failed

BatchStatusResponse.description: Current status and progress of a batch of jobs

status.description: Overall batch status based on aggregate job states

stats.description: Aggregate statistics for all jobs in the batch

total.description: Total number of jobs in the batch

pending.description: Number of jobs still processing or queued

jobs.description: Individual job details within the batch

index.description: Position of this job in the original batch request

status.description: Current job status. Manually cancelled jobs are returned as `manually_cancelled`.

outputUrl.description: URL to the rendered output (available when finished)

stats.description: Job statistics (only included for finished or error states)

BatchCancellationJobResult.description: Cancellation result for a top-level job belonging to the batch.

index.description: Zero-based index of the job within the batch.

id.description: Unique identifier of the top-level batch job.

result.description: Whether the top-level batch job was cancelled or skipped.

status.description: Current state of the top-level job after the cancellation attempt. Manually cancelled jobs are returned as `manually_cancelled`.

BatchCancellationResponse.description: Best-effort cancellation summary for a batch. Counts refer to the top-level jobs stored under the batch ID; cancelledJobs includes all unique jobs actually cancelled, including cascaded relatives.

status.description: cancelled when every top-level batch job was cancelled, partial when some were skipped, unchanged when none were cancellable.

totalJobs.description: Total number of top-level jobs in the batch.

cancelledCount.description: Number of top-level jobs cancelled by the request.

skippedCount.description: Number of top-level jobs skipped because they were already missing or not in a cancellable state.

post.description: Submit a new render job with template, assets, and configuration options. Assets can include nested job definitions (type: 'job') that render as child jobs first, with their output automatically injected as video/image assets into the parent composition. Function assets support `params.layerName` as a string, and selected NX layer functions also support `params.layerName` as an array of strings expanded in order. When nested jobs are present, the parent job enters 'pending' state until all children complete.
